name: Sounds
description: Names the sounds in the room like subtitles: [laughter], [music], [door], [motorbike] … and tags what is behind each spoken line (music, a TV). Needs a sound tagger in the voice pool (the AAC senses service).

threshold.title: Show a sound from (percent sure)
threshold.help: Lower = more sound lines, also wrong ones.

window.title: Listen in pieces of (seconds)
window.help: Between spoken lines the room is tagged in pieces this long (1–10).

speech_tags.title: Tag spoken lines too
speech_tags.help: What is behind a spoken line: music, a TV, laughter … (a hint that it comes from a video).

setup.title: Add a sound tagger
setup.hint: Run the AAC senses service (services/aac_senses in the AAC repository) on a machine, add it under Compute and put it into the voice pool's Sound tagger role.
